summary: Provide per-module CommonJS wrapper bindings exports, require, module, __filename, and __dirname.

target.notes: Create wrapper-local module/exports identity, caller-relative require, and filename/dirname before executing the body.

caveats: These are not ECMAScript globals and must not leak between generated modules.
